chunks: Sulaiman al-Daylami asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the earthquake, what it is, and he said:
"It is a sign." He said, "And what is its cause?" He said:

"Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has entrusted the veins of the earth to an angel. So when Allah wishes to cause a land to quake, He reveals to that angel: Move such-and-such a vein." He said: "Then that angel moves the vein of that land which Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has commanded, and it moves with its inhabitants." He said: I said, "When that happens, what should I do?" He said: "Pray Salat al-Kusuf, and when you finish, fall prostrating to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and say in your سجود: O He who..."
"holds the heavens and the earth lest they cease, and if they should cease, no one could hold them after Him; indeed He is Forbearing, All-Forgiving."
"holds the heaven from falling upon the earth except by His permission,"
withhold evil from us; "indeed You have power over all things."

key_terms.آيَةٌ: a sign; an indication of divine power
key_terms.الزَّلْزَلَةِ: earthquake; the event being asked about
key_terms.السُّوءَ: harm or evil from which protection is sought
key_terms.بِعُرُوقِ الْأَرْضِ: the veins or roots of the earth; the created means mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.سَاجِدًا: in prostration before Allah after completing the prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةَ الْكُسُوفِ: the eclipse prayer, prescribed here in response to an earthquake
key_terms.قَدِيرٌ: All-Powerful; fully able over all things
key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angel entrusted with carrying out Allah’s command

ai.seo_question: What should one do during an earthquake according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the earthquake as a divine sign and describes it within a cosmological framework under Allah’s command. It also teaches a devotional response: performing Salat al-Kusuf and reciting a supplication built from Qur'anic phrases affirming Allah’s sustaining power over creation.
